comment: Quips (GOOFY_IDEAS.md): after a lost point, sometimes, the side that lost it says a line on the point result. PG only: no cursing, no put-downs. Ladder teams have their own in opponents.json; 'player' is a human's side (1P, or 2P in versus), 'cpu' the default CPU. Four each, up to 28 HUD font characters.
